PrivacyMatrix MCP — tool contract

Endpoint: POST https://mcp.barbaros.dev/privacymatrix/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0, JSON responses (no SSE)
Protocol version: 2025-06-18
Auth: none
Headers required: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json

All tools are read-only. No authentication, account, or user data is required beyond the arguments below.
Every answer includes a quote, a source URL, and a verification date; "not legal advice" applies to all output.

---

list_apps()
  -> 28 apps: id, name, vendor, homepage, yes_count (of 14 questions).

list_questions()
  -> 14 questions grouped by topic (training, control, retention, sharing, collection), each with id and text.

get_answer(app: string, question: string)
  app: name, vendor, or id ("ChatGPT", "OpenAI", "chatgpt")
  question: id or natural language ("no_training_default", "does it train on my chats")
  -> { value: yes|partial|no|unknown, quote, evidence_url, notes, confidence, verified_at }

app_report(app: string)
  -> all 14 answers for one app.

compare_apps(apps: string[2..6], questions?: string[])
  -> markdown table + structured rows; one row per question, one column per app; questions defaults to all 14.

best_apps_for(question: string, value?: "yes"|"partial"|"no"|"unknown" = "yes")
  -> apps matching that value for that question, each with quote + source.

search(query: string)
  -> up to 20 cells matching app/vendor/question/notes/quote text.

---

Question ids: no_training_default, training_opt_out, uploads_excluded, business_no_training,
temporary_chat, memory_controls, user_deletion, data_export, deletion_timeline, no_ads_use,
no_sale_sharing, human_review_limited, no_precise_location, rights_channel.

App ids: chatgpt, claude, gemini, copilot, perplexity, grok, meta-ai, deepseek, le-chat,
character-ai, poe, pi, you-com, kimi, qwen-chat, duck-ai, brave-leo, lumo, huggingchat, replika,
apple-intelligence, alexa-plus, snapchat-my-ai, kagi-assistant, venice, manus, genspark, z-ai.
